name: Kozmik Cloud Deck - OpenCode
postStartCommand: export PATH="$HOME/.opencode/bin:$PATH"; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode" ]; then (curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash >/tmp/opencode-install.log 2>&1 || true); fi; if [ -x "$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode" ]; then { while true; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4096/ || echo 000); if [ -z "$code" ] || [ "$code" = '000' ]; then nohup "$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode" web --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 4096 >>/tmp/opencode.log 2>&1 & fi; sleep 15; done; } & fi
